_comment: Development egg for the jstrausd/ferrumc v2 fork, using an image built on the Wings node.
name: FerrumC v2 (local image)
author: 36381849+jstrausd@users.noreply.github.com
description: Minecraft Java 1.21.8 / protocol 772 offline alpha. Locally built Rust server image includes an optional Java 21 compatibility host for a tested Bukkit API subset. Configure config.toml and SERVER_PORT; full Paper compatibility remains in development.

installation.script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

server_dir=/mnt/server
template=/usr/local/share/ferrumc/config.template.toml
mkdir -p "$server_dir/world" "$server_dir/plugins" "$server_dir/java-plugins"
if [ ! -e "$server_dir/config.toml" ] && [ ! -L "$server_dir/config.toml" ]; then
    cp "$template" "$server_dir/config.toml"
fi
# Change only top-level ownership, preserving all existing data and plugin files.
chown -h 1000:1000 "$server_dir" "$server_dir/world" "$server_dir/plugins" "$server_dir/java-plugins" "$server_dir/config.toml"
printf '%s\n' 'FerrumC v2 data directory ready; the executable is supplied by the image.'

variables.name: Log filter
variables.description: Rust tracing filter, for example info or ferrumc_app=debug. Restart after changing it.
